content.text:
I added `"rotateCW"` (↑ key) and the new locking rule; I only checked that the script parses, never ran the game. Rotation turns the piece in its own box. If the turned shape doesn't fit, it tries shifting 0, −1, +1, −2, +2 columns, and otherwise leaves the piece untouched. The lock count restarts when the piece falls, but the 3-restart cap stays with the piece; only a left/right move that succeeds while the piece can't fall counts as a restart, and rotating doesn't.
I rejected full SRS wall-kick tables (the spec only asks for sideways shifts) and letting rotation restart the lock delay (the spec names only left/right).
